title: Szczecin Cathedral
geometryBasis: Native building way 53263911 and native heritage identifier Q337871. The perimeter includes the stepped masonry and apsidal buttresses. Photographs set the roof hierarchy and the city gives the exact restored tower height.
sectionBasis: Szczecin’s city heritage account documents the 110.18 m restored spire. Rüdiger Schlott’s post-restoration photo and Kapitel’s exact crown detail show the retained Gothic tower, analog dials, copper-toned spire and four corner pinnacles. Horvat’s earlier clear view supports only the standing choir and the broad green nave roof.
limitations: The present church and restored west spire are modeled. Separate nearby houses and stained-glass interiors are outside the scope.
The original and restored tower features, broad green roof and wall alignments are grounded in the photos and mapped building. Fine masonry patterns and chapel roofs are representative.
The open elevation field resolves the general street slope only; exact curb heights are below its source resolution.
